title: Prove when order disappears
promptMarkdown: Prove permutation equivariance of unmasked self-attention with shared linear projections and no positional signal. Show that mean pooling makes the output invariant to token permutation. Use this to explain why a classifier of the sequencesAB andBA with opposite labels cannot solve the task under this exact architecture. Then name two architectural changes that invalidate the proof and explain which equality changes.
hintLadder: Write both left and right permutation actions onQKᵀ.
Check what mean pooling does to a permuted row order.
Identify the assumption violated rather than claiming the algebra itself is wrong.
